scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of require('fs').readdirSync('packages')) require('fs').rmSync('packages/' + p + '/dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && find packages -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -delete
scripts.check:packages: npm run clean && npm run build && node scripts/check-packages.mjs
